podcast.body: This acclaimed album featured "She's Got Soul" as its lead single. It was released after Lowe had already become a millionaire from royalties, demonstrating his continued dedication to making music without resting on his laurels. "And she's got soul, the lead single from his acclaimed 2001 album The Convinces."
